map.配比能直接用吗？: Can the mix be used directly?
map.不能。正式工程须由实验室出具配合比报告，并依砂石含水率实时调整。本工具给经验量级: No. Formal works need a lab mix report, adjusted live by aggregate moisture. This tool gives empirical magnitude.
map.水加多会怎样？: What if too much water is added?
map.水灰比增大强度下降、易开裂离析；现场为方便浇筑乱加水是常见质量隐患，应严格控水。: Higher water-cement ratio lowers strength and risks cracking/segregation; random watering on site is a common quality hazard; control water strictly.
map.C20 和 C30 差多少？: How much differ C20 and C30?
map.强度等级差 10MPa，水泥用量与水灰比不同；大体量下标号每升一级材料与成本明显: Grade gap is 10MPa, with different cement use and ratio; at large volume each step up clearly raises material and cost.
